name: fox_audit_page
description: [Deprecated: fox_audit_page is deprecated and will be removed: it is not implemented on any backend.] Not implemented yet on any backend: always returns an error. Use fox_get_page_info, fox_get_elements and fox_screenshot instead.

name: fox_click
description: Click an element, located by selector (CSS), xpath, text or x+y viewport coordinates, checked in that order. Works in the top document only (not inside iframes or shadow DOM); fails on a disabled element. The element is scrolled into view and receives synthetic mousedown/mouseup/click events (isTrusted=false, not a real OS click; pages that require real user input may ignore it). doubleClick/rightClick send dblclick/contextmenu instead. Returns the clicked element's info. Headless: selector or x+y only.

text.description: Visible text of the element: the innermost element whose whole text contains it (case-sensitive; enabled, visible matches first). Top document only: not inside iframes or shadow DOM

name: fox_close_tab
description: [Deprecated: fox_close_tab is deprecated; use fox_tab with action='close'.] Close a browser tab by its tab ID.

tabId.description: ID of the tab to close

name: fox_create_tab
description: [Deprecated: fox_create_tab is deprecated; use fox_tab with action='create'.] Create a new browser tab, optionally with a URL.

url.description: URL to open in the new tab

name: fox_detect_captcha
description: Detect captchas on the page (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, generic image captchas). Reports what was found so the human can be asked to solve it. Does NOT auto-solve.

name: fox_find_text
description: [Deprecated: fox_find_text is deprecated; use fox_find with by='text'.] Search for text in the page using the native browser.find API (Firefox-only). Works across frames and finds text outside the viewport without DOM traversal. Returns match count and optionally bounding rects.

query.description: Text to search for in the page

includeRectData.description: Include bounding rect data for matches

name: fox_get_elements
description: [Deprecated: fox_get_elements is deprecated; use fox_find with by='selector'.] List elements matching a CSS selector (querySelectorAll: the first `limit` matches, plus the total count). Per element: tag, id, classes, name, type, text (first 200 chars), value, href, src, placeholder, ariaLabel, role, disabled, checked, visible, position (viewport coordinates incl. centerX/centerY) and a generated CSS selector. Values and texts of password, hidden, one-time-code and payment card (autocomplete cc-*) fields, and the options of such a select are masked. A selector that tests the value or selected attribute (such as [value^="a"] or option[selected]) or uses :checked or :default is refused, as is one longer than 1024 characters: it could tell a masked value one guess at a time. Headless: plain CSS only (no xpath=, text=, role=, //, >> or other Playwright selector forms). Headless: tag, text and bounding box only, at most 50.

name: fox_get_page_info
description: [Deprecated: fox_get_page_info is deprecated; use fox_read with mode='info'.] Get an overview of the current page: URL, title, document/viewport size, scroll position, up to 100 visible interactive elements (tag, type, id, name, text, href, value, placeholder, ariaLabel, center position, generated selector), forms with their first 20 fields, and h1-h3 headings. Values of password, hidden, one-time-code and payment card (autocomplete cc-*) fields, and the options of such a select are masked. Not in any FOX_CAPS profile. Headless: URL and title only.

name: fox_get_tabs
description: [Deprecated: fox_get_tabs is deprecated; use fox_tabs with what='tabs'.] List open browser tabs: id, url, title, active, windowId, pinned, status (loading/complete), audible; plus totals and a summary. Defaults to the current window and at most 50 tabs. Use urlPattern (regex, applied before limit) to filter, currentWindowOnly=false for all windows, includeFavicon=true for favicon URLs. Headless: id, url, title and active only; arguments are ignored.

currentWindowOnly.description: Only list tabs in the current window

urlPattern.description: Only tabs whose URL matches this regex, before applying limit. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

name: fox_get_text
description: [Deprecated: fox_get_text is deprecated; use fox_read with mode='text'.] Extract the visible text content of the page or a specific element. Lighter-weight than a screenshot for reading page content. The text of a masked field reads as [MASKED] (masked: password, hidden, one-time-code and payment card (autocomplete cc-*) fields, and the options of such a select). A selector that tests the value or selected attribute (such as [value^="a"] or option[selected]) or uses :checked or :default is refused, as is one longer than 1024 characters: it could tell a masked value one guess at a time. Headless: plain CSS only (no xpath=, text=, role=, //, >> or other Playwright selector forms).

selector.description: CSS selector; defaults to the whole page body

maxLength.description: Truncate returned text to this many characters

name: fox_handle_dialog
description: Extension path: not implemented (returns an error; commands to a tab showing an alert/confirm/prompt time out there). Headless only: wait for the next dialog and accept or dismiss it (promptText for prompts). Call it before the action that opens the dialog: it does not block other commands, and when no dialog comes within timeout it arms itself for the next dialog on the tab (30 s). Dialogs nobody handles are dismissed automatically after 2 s and reported in the next result of that tab. Not in any FOX_CAPS profile.

action.description: Whether to accept or dismiss the dialog

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog before accepting

name: fox_highlight
description: [Deprecated: fox_highlight is deprecated; use fox_interact with action='highlight'.] Highlight an element on the page with a colored overlay for visual debugging. Optionally show a label. Returns at most the element's tag, generated selector and position, never its text, value or links. A selector that tests the value or selected attribute (such as [value^="a"] or option[selected]) or uses :checked or :default is refused, as is one longer than 1024 characters: it could tell a masked value one guess at a time. Headless: plain CSS only (no xpath=, text=, role=, //, >> or other Playwright selector forms).

label.description: Label to show above the element

name: fox_hover
description: [Deprecated: fox_hover is deprecated; use fox_interact with action='hover'.] Hover over an element to trigger hover effects, tooltips, or dropdown menus. Dispatches synthetic mouseenter / mouseover events (isTrusted=false): JavaScript hover handlers run, CSS :hover styles do not apply. Since the page's own handlers run, it asks the human first like the acting tools, and read-only mode refuses it. Returns at most the element's tag, generated selector and position, never its text, value or links.

name: fox_list_containers
description: [Deprecated: fox_list_containers is deprecated; use fox_tabs with what='containers'.] List Firefox container identities (contextualIdentities). Returns name, color, icon, and cookieStoreId for each container. When container scope is enabled in safety.json, only the agent container is returned.

name: fox_navigate
description: Navigate in the browser. Actions: 'goto' (open a URL), 'back' / 'forward' (history navigation), 'refresh' (reload page), 'hard_refresh' (bypass cache, like Ctrl+Shift+R). goto / refresh with waitForLoad, and back / forward always, fail when the page does not finish loading within 25 s or the tab is closed (the navigation itself may still complete).

url.description: URL to navigate to (required for goto; not allowed with the other actions)

newTab.description: Open URL in new tab (for goto)

waitForLoad.description: Wait for page to fully load

name: fox_open_in_container
description: [Deprecated: fox_open_in_container is deprecated; use fox_tab with action='create'.] Open a URL in a Firefox container tab. Specify the container by containerName (created if not found) or by cookieStoreId (must already exist). Provides isolated cookies/storage via the contextualIdentities API. When container scope is enabled in safety.json, only the agent container is allowed.

url.description: URL to open in the container tab

containerName.description: Container name to use (creates if not found)

cookieStoreId.description: cookieStoreId of an existing container (e.g. "firefox-container-1", as returned by fox_list_containers). Takes precedence over containerName

name: fox_press_key
description: Press a keyboard key with optional modifiers (Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Meta) on the element located by selector (CSS), xpath, text or id (checked in that order; it is focused first), else on the focused element. The key events are synthetic (isTrusted=false): page handlers see them, but the browser performs no default action (no focus move on Tab, no scrolling, no browser shortcuts). Plain Enter in a form field submits the form like a real Enter. Headless: selector only; real key presses, so on a password field keys that could change its value are refused (Enter, Tab, Escape, arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and lone modifiers are allowed).

text.description: Visible text of the element: the innermost element whose whole text contains it (case-sensitive; enabled, visible matches first). Top document only: not inside iframes or shadow DOM

name: fox_request_approval
description: Ask the human at the browser a yes/no question and wait for the answer. Shown in the InariMCP toolbar popup in Firefox (badge + OS notification), never in the page. The answer is for you only: it approves no tool call — acting tools ask the human on their own when you call them. Unavailable in headless mode.

message.description: What you are asking permission to do, in plain language

detail.description: Optional extra context shown in smaller text

name: fox_run_workflow
description: [Deprecated: fox_run_workflow is deprecated and will be removed: it is not implemented on any backend.] Not implemented yet on any backend: always returns an error. Call the individual tools instead.

tool.description: Browser tool to call, e.g. fox_navigate, fox_click, fox_type

urlContains.description: Current URL must contain this substring

textContains.description: Visible page text must contain this substring

selectorExists.description: This CSS selector must match at least one element

assert.description: Checks to run after the step succeeds

stopOnFailure.description: Stop at the first failing step

screenshotOnFailure.description: Capture a screenshot when a step fails

name: fox_safety_status
description: Show the active safety guard policy: which calls ask the human for approval, read-only mode, blocked/allowed URL patterns and confirm_read_sites, rate-limit state, and audit log location.

name: fox_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot. scope: viewport (visible area; a background tab given by tabId is captured without switching to it; a discarded tab fails), full_page (entire scrollable page; falls back to the visible area when it cannot, fullPageCaptured=false), all_tabs (every tab, or those whose URL matches the urlPattern regex, within the timeout budget; tabs on sites listed in confirm_read_sites are skipped; fails when no tab could be captured), scroll_capture (takes NO images: scrolls the page and returns the interactive elements visible at each position). Images are saved to files and returned as resource_link, never as base64; saveToFile=false captures nothing, includeData has no effect, and the same filename overwrites the file. Headless: viewport and full_page only.

scope.description: Capture scope: viewport (default), full_page, all_tabs, or scroll_capture

saveToFile.description: Save the image to a file and return it as a resource_link (default). Images are never returned inline, so false captures nothing and only returns the tab info (headless: ignored, always saved)

urlPattern.description: all_tabs: only tabs whose URL matches this regex. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

includeData.description: No effect: base64 image data is never returned; all_tabs images are saved to files like the others

timeout.description: all_tabs: time budget for capturing all tabs in ms (default 20000); tabs left when it runs out are reported as skipped

scrollStep.description: Pixels to scroll each step (default: 80% of viewport)

delay.description: Delay between scrolls in ms (for scroll_capture scope)

maxScrolls.description: Maximum number of scroll steps (for scroll_capture scope)

restore.description: Restore original scroll position after capture

name: fox_scroll
description: [Deprecated: fox_scroll is deprecated; use fox_interact with action='scroll'.] Scroll the page or a specific element in any direction, or scroll a target element into view. Returns at most the element's tag, generated selector and position, never its text, value or links. A selector that tests the value or selected attribute (such as [value^="a"] or option[selected]) or uses :checked or :default is refused, as is one longer than 1024 characters: it could tell a masked value one guess at a time. Headless: plain CSS only (no xpath=, text=, role=, //, >> or other Playwright selector forms).

toElement.description: CSS selector of element to scroll into view

name: fox_select_option
description: [Deprecated: fox_select_option is deprecated; use fox_set_value with kind='select'.] Select an option in a dropdown/select element by value, visible text, or index.

selector.description: CSS selector for the select element

name: fox_set_value
description: Set the value of an input, textarea, select or contenteditable element directly (no key events), then dispatch input and change events. Faster than fox_type and suited to long values. Reports success even when the element is of another kind (nothing changes) or, for a select, when no option has that value. Password fields are refused. Not in any FOX_CAPS profile.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element

name: fox_snapshot
description: Extension path: not implemented (returns an error); use fox_get_page_info, fox_get_elements or fox_get_text there. Headless: returns the accessibility tree of the page (or of the first element matching selector) as indented YAML text (Playwright ariaSnapshot), filtered by maxDepth, includeText and roles, cut at 50000 characters.

selector.description: CSS selector to snapshot a subtree (defaults to full page)

includeText.description: Include text content in snapshot nodes

name: fox_switch_tab
description: [Deprecated: fox_switch_tab is deprecated; use fox_tab with action='switch'.] Focus/activate a browser tab by its tab ID.

tabId.description: ID of the tab to focus/activate

name: fox_type
description: Type text into an input, textarea or contenteditable element, located by selector, id, name or placeholder (in that order); without any of them, types into the focused field. The `text` value is never used to find the element. Fails on a disabled element; password fields are refused. Types character by character with synthetic key events (isTrusted=false), waiting `delay` ms per character (0 = none; shortened so all delays stay within 10 s); fox_set_value is faster for long values. clear empties the field first. pressEnter also submits the enclosing form like a real Enter (unless a keydown handler cancels it). Headless: selector, text and clear only (with selector the text is appended unless clear, else the focused element receives the keys).

text.description: Text to type (never used to find the element)

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element

placeholder.description: Placeholder text to find the input

pressEnter.description: Press Enter after typing. In a form field this also submits the form the way a real Enter does (unless a keydown handler cancels it); the result reports it in `enter`

delay.description: Delay between keystrokes in ms (0 = none). Reduced automatically so that all delays together stay within 10 s

name: fox_wait_for_element
description: [Deprecated: fox_wait_for_element is deprecated; use fox_wait with for='element'.] Wait for an element matching a CSS selector to appear (and optionally become visible) on the page. Returns at most the element's tag, generated selector and position, never its text, value or links. A selector that tests the value or selected attribute (such as [value^="a"] or option[selected]) or uses :checked or :default is refused, as is one longer than 1024 characters: it could tell a masked value one guess at a time. Headless: plain CSS only (no xpath=, text=, role=, //, >> or other Playwright selector forms).

visible.description: Wait for element to be visible

name: fox_wait_for_navigation
description: [Deprecated: fox_wait_for_navigation is deprecated; use fox_wait with for='navigation'.] Wait for the tab's next top-level navigation to finish (waitUntil: load or domcontentloaded), optionally only one whose URL matches the urlPattern regex. Only navigations that finish after this call count: a fast navigation already done (e.g. right after fox_click) is missed and the call times out. When the destination URL is known, prefer fox_wait_for_url, which returns at once if the URL already matches. Headless: urlPattern is ignored (any navigation ends the wait).

urlPattern.description: Regex the URL of the navigation must match (other navigations are skipped). JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.

name: fox_wait_for_network_idle
description: [Deprecated: fox_wait_for_network_idle is deprecated; use fox_wait with for='network_idle'.] Wait until the page's own fetch/XHR requests (top frame) have been idle for idleTime ms. Use after actions that trigger API calls. Requests already in flight when the call starts are not seen. Fails when the network does not become idle within the timeout. Headless: uses Playwright's networkidle; idleTime is ignored.

idleTime.description: How long network must be idle (ms)

name: fox_wait_for_url
description: [Deprecated: fox_wait_for_url is deprecated; use fox_wait with for='url'.] Wait until the current URL matches an exact string or regex pattern. Useful for waiting on redirects or SPA route changes.

urlPattern.description: Regex the tab URL must match. JavaScript regex, case-sensitive, unanchored (matches anywhere in the full URL); use [Ee]xample for a case-insensitive part.
